aboutUs.title: About ELWALEED EXPORT
aboutUs.heading: From Our Egyptian Farms to Global Markets
aboutUs.description: ELWALEED EXPORT is an Egyptian agricultural export company with its own farms and packing stations, specializing in the cultivation, packing, and export of fresh fruits and vegetables to international markets.
aboutUs.description2: From cultivation and harvesting to sorting, grading, packing, and export, we maintain direct control over our products throughout the process to ensure quality, freshness, consistency, and professional handling.
aboutUs.mission: To bring the quality of Egyptian agriculture to customers around the world through our own farms, packing facilities, and reliable export operations.
